findings.session_b_note:
For the vertical fellowship groups (873-001, 5367-001), the evidence suggests that the origin and constitution of this mode of fellowship is at the spirit level — it is God who grants participation (2Pe 1:4), and the communion with Father and Son (1Jo 1:3) is the kind of relational reality the programme associates with the spirit register. However, the fellowship vocabulary covers a wide constitutional range: at the lower register (H2270 companionship, H2266 physical joining), the operation appears at the social-moral level rather than the spirit level. Fellowship as a whole characteristic is not primarily a spirit-level phenomenon — it spans all constitutional levels from physical joining (chavar root: structural, somatic) to spirit-level participation in divine nature.

**Gap:** The question of which register of fellowship is primary — and therefore which constitutional level governs the characteristic overall — is a Session D synthesis question. DIM-62-SD001 captures this precisely.

findings.session_b_note: The Spirit-infusion evidence (Rom 5:5, OBS-103-126; Gal 5:22, OBS-103-128) points toward spirit-level origin in the sense of divine-Spirit origination — love's origin is the Holy Spirit's action, not the human spirit's generation. The commanded form ('you shall love' — Mat 22:37) places love at the will level, which in the programme's framework operates at or near the spirit boundary. Chesed as covenantal faithfulness — the mode that persists regardless of feeling — has a spirit-character quality: it operates at the deepest stable-disposition level rather than the feeling-fluctuating soul level. The sb_classification 'Spirit-Soul Interface' captures this: love has its deepest origin and most stable form at the spirit level but is also experienced at the soul level. The evidence implies spirit-level origin without explicitly naming it.

findings.session_b_note: Cited as source by SYN-INTRA-023-002: T2 produces the most distinctive constitutional portrait in the current review set. Spirit-level location is entirely absent — three consecutive S ratings — forming a new gap. By contrast, soul-level …
findings.finding_value: T2 produces the most distinctive constitutional portrait in the current review set. Spirit-level location is entirely absent — three consecutive S ratings — forming a new gap. By contrast, soul-level (chesed as covenantal-soul character), heart-level (Hos 11:8 — "my heart recoils"), and somatic-level (re.chem, splanchnon) are all richly evidenced. The constitutional architecture is bottom-up: the womb and entrails are the originating ground; the soul and heart are the engagement points; the act is the constitutional expression. Four body-part functions are identified: constitutive (womb — the generative image of compassion), expressive (gut — the felt movement), indicative (Synoptic pattern — splanchnizō signals the compassion-event), and mediating (heart in Hos 11:8 — the deliberative locus where compassion and judgment contend). The four-stage constitutional movement sequence (somatic arousal → soul engagement → volitional engagement → outward action) is uniquely evidenced in this registry — consistently inside-out and bottom-up. T2.8 established no body deposit; T5.7 is formally closed. The constitutional portrait confirms the sb_classification (soul-body interface) and extends it: compassion is the most somatically grounded characteristic in the programme, with its originating logic residing in the body's deepest interior.

findings.session_b_note: Cited as source by SYN-INTER-023-008: T1's four-kind structure (character quality, inner event, condition of object, externalised act) maps precisely onto T2's constitutional levels. The character-quality kind (ra.chum — dispositional com…
findings.finding_value: T1's four-kind structure (character quality, inner event, condition of object, externalised act) maps precisely onto T2's constitutional levels. The character-quality kind (ra.chum — dispositional compassionate character) operates at the soul level (T2.2 — chesed as soul-character). The inner-event kind (splanchnizō — the moment of being-moved) operates at the somatic level (T2.6 — the gut as the site of the stirring). The condition-of-object kind (eleeinos — the pitiable state) is the constitutional trigger that activates the somatic-constitutional movement. The externalised-act kind is the constitutional endpoint of T2.10's four-stage movement sequence. T1's definition and T2's constitutional account are co-determining: the characteristic cannot be adequately defined without specifying the constitutional levels at which its four kinds operate.

findings.session_b_note: Cited as source by SYN-INTRA-068-002: T2 produces the clearest constitutional portrait of any characteristic in the current review set. The sb_classification (spirit-soul interface) is confirmed with precision: spirit level is the primary…
findings.finding_value: T2 produces the clearest constitutional portrait of any characteristic in the current review set. The sb_classification (spirit-soul interface) is confirmed with precision: spirit level is the primary point of reception (Zec 12:10 — spirit of grace poured out), not the point of generation (grace originates with God — T2.9). The soul level is the site of standing (Rom 5:2 — "this grace in which we stand") and identity (1Cor 15:10 — "by the grace of God I am what I am"). The constitutional movement follows the SD021 four-faces model: divine disposition received at spirit level → relational standing established at soul level → specific capacity gifted → character expressed outward. Heart-location is partially evidenced via eusplanchnos (Eph 4:32 — the tenderheartedness that grace produces, reaching the affective-somatic interface). T2.7 produces a new finding: grace operates bidirectionally through the body-soul interface — soul-to-body (inner posture enacted somatically in prostration, fasting, sackcloth) and body-to-soul (somatic enactment deepening and confirming the inner posture). T2.8 remains open (body deposit question unresolved); T5.7 is left open accordingly. The constitutional origin analysis (T2.9) is the most analytically significant T2 finding: grace does not originate in the human constitutional system at any level — it arrives from outside. This is confirmed at T6 as the structural uniqueness of grace: the only characteristic that is not produced by any other inner-being characteristic.

The human-to-God direction (T4.2 — supplication) corresponds to T2.10's constitutional movement in reverse: the soul's recognition of need translates into the somatic enactment of supplication (prostration, fasting, sackcloth), which is T2.7's bidirectional body-soul finding. findings.finding_value: T2's constitutional levels are carried by specific grammatical forms in T7. The spirit-reception level (T2.1) is carried by the perfect passive form of charitoō (kecharitōmenē — the completed act of being-made-the-object-of-grace, with continuing state) — the most precise grammatical encoding of a constitutional arrival that has permanently changed the person's standing. The soul-standing level (T2.2) is carried by charis as noun (the inhabited state of favour) and chen as the relational standing-in-favour term. The character-expression level is carried by chen in its conduct/speech register (889-003) and charizō in its human-forgiving mode. T7's NT coinage finding (charitoō invented to carry the standing-in-favour concept) is the lexical evidence that T2's spirit-level reception was conceptually unprecedented — no prior vocabulary could name what happened constitutionally when grace-as-standing arrived.

findings.session_b_note: For the divine side: covenant originates in God's own relational disposition — which in biblical categories is a spirit-level reality (God is spirit). God's faithfulness to covenant is grounded in his own inner character, which is not reduced to body or soul. For the human side: the evidence is not conclusive. The 2 Cor 3:6 contrast — "not of the letter but of the Spirit" (OBS-034-061) — suggests the new covenant operates at the level of the Spirit (divine Spirit enabling human spirit responsiveness) rather than the external letter. The Spirit of God acts upon and within the human person to enact the new covenant. Whether this constitutes a spirit-level constitutional location for covenant in the human person is not directly stated. What can be said: the new covenant's operation requires the Spirit's presence and action within the human person — which implies engagement at the deepest constitutional level, which in the programme's framework is spirit-level.

findings.finding_value: T2 reveals a clear and important constitutional asymmetry for kindness: the heart is its named constitutional site (Pro 3:3 — explicitly inscribed there), while the soul, mind, and body are not named locations — the soul appears as beneficiary, the mind as instrument, the body as the direction of outward expression. This asymmetry is not a gap in the evidence but a structural feature: kindness is a heart-level characteristic. Its constitutional movement is a coherent downward-outward trajectory — Spirit-formation produces the heart-level disposition, which in turn generates deliberate relational acts. The origin of kindness is triple: divinely initiated (in God's own character), Spirit-mediated (Gal 5:22), and humanly formed (the chasid's character accumulated through covenantal faithfulness). These three are not competing explanations but sequential layers of the same formation process. T2's most significant intra-tier finding: the body-deposit question (T2.8) closes formally — no deposit evidence exists — which confirms that kindness does not transmit generationally through biological means but through covenantal-formative means (Exo 20:6 — "to a thousand generations" = covenantal, not biological).

findings.session_b_note: Spirit-level origin is supported in the NT but not dominant. The evidence suggests peace originates at the spirit level (through the Spirit's presence) but is experienced throughout the person. Not primarily located in the spirit as its constitutional home — the heart and soul are the more explicit locations.

The glory-giving (872-006) operates at the relational-correspondence level without explicit spirit-level identification. Assessment: spirit-level location is evidenced in two of seven groups; it is not the primary constitutional home of the characteristic across the full corpus.

findings.session_b_note: Cited as source by SYN-INTRA-060-002: T2 as a whole reveals that this characteristic has no single constitutional home — it operates across the full spirit-soul-body register through different modes. Spirit is the location in two modes: a…
findings.finding_value: T2 as a whole reveals that this characteristic has no single constitutional home — it operates across the full spirit-soul-body register through different modes. Spirit is the location in two modes: as the object of endowing giving (Neh 9:20) and as the faculty transformed eschatologically (Isa 61:3). Soul (nephesh/nafshi) appears in divine self-reference in the giving-over context (Jer 12:7). Heart (leb) is the faculty where the giving decision is made (Hos 11:8). Hidden inner parts (tukhoth) are the target of wisdom-giving (Job 38:36). Rahamim (visceral compassion) is the inner-being quality that determines giving direction. Body appears as the expressive medium of self-giving (Isa 50:6) and as constituted by breath-giving (Isa 42:5). No constitutional body deposit is confirmed. Three movement patterns — constitutive (spirit→mind), expressive (inner→body), transformative (outside-in→inside renewed→inside-out) — show the characteristic is constitutionally dynamic. What T2 reveals as a whole: this characteristic operates at every constitutional level not because it is superficially distributed but because giving as an inner-being act can reach the spirit (endowing), the heart (deciding), the soul (attaching), the hidden inner parts (forming), and the body (expressing and constituting). It is constitutionally pervasive.

For the trembling-at-word tradition (Isa 66:2; Ezr 9:4; 10:3), the evidence suggests spirit-level origin. Isa 66:2 pairs the spirit-trembling with "humility and a contrite spirit" — both spirit-level characteristics in the programme. The trembling appears to flow from a spirit-posture of reverence, not from somatic arousal.

For timidity (M01-G), the 2Ti 1:7 evidence explicitly names it as spirit-level in origin — "a spirit-level disposition that God has not implanted." The origin is at the spirit, not a downstream effect of other inner states.

The cluster's evidence confirms that the vast majority of M01's inner-being content does not originate at the spirit level. Spirit-level origin is confirmed for: (1) M01-G timidity (2Ti 1:7) and (2) M01-E-VCG-02 reverential trembling (Isa 66:2). The cluster's primary constitutional home is the heart (see T2.3), not the spirit. This is a significant finding: fear as experienced in Scripture is predominantly a heart-and-body phenomenon rather than a spirit-level one.

The spirit-level location evidences in Eze 3:14 and Act 17:16 show anger arising at the spirit level. Additionally, 1Sa 11:6 (M02-B-VCG-02) shows Saul's anger as Spirit-empowered when the Spirit of God rushes upon him — the Spirit is the enabling power behind the anger's intensity and direction. This suggests that in its most fully calibrated form, anger is a spirit-level phenomenon — or at minimum, can be engaged and directed from the spirit level.

The evidence does not indicate that M03's characteristic is primarily spirit-level in origin. The spirit-level attestations are present but limited (Job 7:11; Rom 8:26). The cluster's mass of evidence locates grief in the soul and heart (see T2.2 and T2.3), not primarily in the spirit. Spirit-level location is a confirmed but secondary constitutional site for this characteristic.

**[CHAR-1]** S — The evidence does not support spirit-level origin for exultation in this corpus. The primary constitutional language names the soul and heart (see T2.2 and T2.3). Spirit-level location is not evidenced.

**[CHAR-2]** E — Partially. The NT Spirit-mediated joy (Act 13:52; 1Th 1:6; Gal 5:22; Rom 14:17) shows that in its most intense and paradoxical forms (joy in affliction, joy under persecution), Joy is produced at the spirit level by the Spirit himself. However, the dominant OT constitutional home is the heart (not the spirit), and the M04-B corpus (281 verses, the largest sub-group) does not name the spirit as the primary location. Joy originates at multiple constitutional levels depending on register: in the heart (primary for the OT communal-festive corpus), in the spirit (primary for the NT Spirit-produced paradoxical joy), and at the whole-being level for its most comprehensive expressions.

**[CHAR-7]** E — Yes, in its primary (agalliao) register. Luk 10:21 makes this explicit for Jesus; Luk 1:47 for Mary. The Spirit as the origin and enabler of the exultant quality of Suffering-Joy is confirmed: 1Th 1:6's "joy of the Holy Spirit" received in affliction names the Spirit as the producing agent. The ba.lag fragile register (M04-F) is not Spirit-located in this way — it is the unaided human attempt at cheerfulness, suggesting the spirit-level location is specific to the Spirit-enabled form and absent from the fragile-attempt form.

**[CHAR-3]** S — Not evidenced. The primary constitutional language is cognitive-evaluative (the faculty of discernment) and situational-affective (warm inner response). No origin at the spirit level is evidenced.

**[CHAR-4]** S — Not evidenced. The primary constitutional language for Delight's origin is the heart and the inner being — not the spirit. God's Spirit is not named as the producer of Delight in this corpus (contrast with Characteristic 7's Suffering-Joy where the Spirit is the explicit producing agent). Delight appears as a characteristic of the soul and heart that is constitutionally native rather than Spirit-produced.

**[CHAR-5]** S — Not evidenced. Pleasure in this corpus arises at the soul-body interface (Pro 16:24) and in the soul's receptive response to what is agreeable — not at the spirit level. The characteristic's most distinctive constitutional feature is its explicit body-level engagement (Pro 16:24; Deu 28:54–56; Isa 47:1), which is the opposite of a spirit-level origin.

**[CHAR-6]** S — Not evidenced. Wonder arises at the cognitive-perceptive boundary — when what is encountered exceeds the mind's categories. This is a soul-level perceptive-cognitive event rather than a Spirit-level impartation. The absent Spirit-level evidence is consistent with Wonder's characteristically creaturely nature: it does not require Spirit-production but is the natural inner response of the finite being encountering the infinite.

**[CLUSTER]** E — Spirit-level origin is evidenced primarily for Suffering-Joy (Char 7) — confirmed as the most Spirit-constituted characteristic in the cluster. Joy (Char 2) is partially Spirit-originated in its NT intense registers but predominantly heart-originated in its OT communal registers. The remaining five characteristics originate primarily in the soul, heart, and cognitive faculty respectively: Exultation (soul and heart), Gladness (cognitive-evaluative faculty), Delight (soul and inner being), Pleasure (soul and body), Wonder (cognitive-perceptive faculty). The pattern confirms a spectrum: from the deepest Spirit-constitutional level (Suffering-Joy) through the partially Spirit-constituted (Joy in its most intense form) through the soul-heart constituted (Exultation, Delight) through the cognitively-constituted (Gladness, Wonder) to the bodily-constituted (Pleasure — the most constitutionally embodied of the seven).

**[CHAR-1]** S — Not evidenced. The primary constitutional location across the corpus is soul-level (the felt inner experience, the conscience, the will responding). The absence of spirit-level language in the shame corpus is itself analytically significant — shame appears to operate at the soul and body level rather than the spirit.

**[CHAR-2]** S — The 72-verse CHAR-2 corpus does not explicitly locate enforced humiliation at the spirit level. The sha.phel evidence targets inner orientations (pride) but does not name ruach/pneuma as the constitutional locus. Silent on spirit-level location.

---

**[CHAR-3]** S — The 15-verse CHAR-3 corpus does not explicitly locate worth-denial at the spirit level. Silent.

---

**[CHAR-4]** S — The 16-verse CHAR-4 corpus does not explicitly locate the shamefulness-evaluative judgment at the spirit level. Silent.

---

**[CHAR-5]** S — The 24-verse CHAR-5 corpus does not explicitly locate contempt-produced shame at the spirit level. Silent.

---

**[CHAR-6]** S — The 8-verse CHAR-6 corpus does not explicitly locate innocence at the spirit level. Silent.

---

**[CLUSTER]** S — All six characteristics are silent on explicit spirit-level location. This is the most consistent silence across the entire cluster: none of the 363 substantive verses in M07 explicitly names the ruach/pneuma as the constitutional locus of shame, humiliation, dishonour, shamefulness, contempt-produced shame, or innocence. The cluster-level significance: M07's inner-being domain operates primarily at the soul-conscience-will-body interface rather than at the spirit level. This distinguishes M07 from clusters whose primary constitutional location is the spirit explicitly. Whether this represents a genuine characteristic of shame's constitutional location or a limit of the verse evidence is a question for Session D synthesis.

**[CHAR-1]** E — The evidence does not indicate that CHAR-1 originates primarily at the spirit level. The heart is named far more frequently as the constitutional seat (M08-A1: 30 verses with explicit heart-location, compared to three spirit-level references). The spirit-level evidence (Pro 16:18, vc=34073; Ecc 7:8, vc=12087; Dan 5:20, vc=34129) is complementary — naming the spirit as a site where CHAR-1 also registers — rather than primary. Dan 5:20 (vc=34129, M08-A1-VCG-02) is the most instructive: it presents heart-lifting and spirit-hardening as simultaneous co-occurrents, not as a spirit-origin generating a secondary heart-manifestation. The evidence supports CHAR-1 as a phenomenon primarily headquartered in the heart, with secondary extension to the spirit.

**[CHAR-2]** S — The evidence is silent on spirit-level origination for CHAR-2. The will (volitional faculty) is the primary named constitutional driver, not the spirit. The stiff-neck idiom (Neh 9:16, vc=34120, M08-B-VCG-01; Neh 9:29, vc=34126) may carry spirit-level resonances within the broader constitutional framework but is not named as such within §3.A.

**[CHAR-3]** S — The evidence does not indicate spirit-level origination. The primary constitutional substrate evidenced is the inner disposition (alazoneia), the cognitive self-assessment process (2Cor 10:12), and the heart's orientational state (2Cor 5:12, vc=33872). Not spirit-level.

**[CHAR-4]** S — No evidence of spirit-level origination. CHAR-4 originates in the cognitive/mind faculty — Col 2:18 (vc=33941, M08-D-VCG-01): "inflated by his sensuous mind [nous]" — the mind is the named origin-site.
**[CHAR-5]** S — No evidence of spirit-level origination. CHAR-5 originates in the heart (Eze 28:5; Eze 16:30; Isa 47:8), activated by external structural goods.

**[CLUSTER]** E — Only CHAR-1 is evidenced with spirit-level involvement, and only partially — the spirit is one of CHAR-1's locations alongside the heart and eyes, not its exclusive seat. The cluster-synthesis: spirit-level origination is not the primary constitutional description of any M08 characteristic; even CHAR-1's spirit-level evidence is secondary to its heart-level evidence. The cluster's centre of constitutional gravity is the heart, not the spirit.

**[CHAR-2]** E — Not directly, but the depth implied by several verses is consistent with spirit-level operation. 1Pe1:22 — obedience to truth "purifies the soul itself" — a depth of inner operation that suggests transformation at a level below ordinary volition. Heb5:8 — Christ "learning" obedience through suffering implies a deep interior process of formation rather than surface-level compliance. The "sincere heart" language (Eph6:5; Col3:22) and "fear of God" (Phili2:12; Col3:22) suggest the characteristic's genuine form operates at the deepest personal level, consistent with spirit-level origin, though not explicitly named as such.

**[CHAR-3]** E — Yes. The primary vocabulary in both verses is ruach (spirit) — the spirit is the constitutional level most directly named as the location of the crushed/contrite state. The heart is also named (Psa34:18 — brokenhearted; Isa57:15 — "revive the heart of the contrite") but the spirit is the first-named and dominant location. The origin-point of the characteristic is the spirit-level — the crushing reaches the spirit first; the heart is the secondary constitutional level named in relation to it.

**[CHAR-4]** S — The evidence does not directly evidence spirit-level origin. The grounding of metriopatheō in "shared weakness" (Heb5:2) suggests the characteristic originates in a self-knowledge that may reach the spirit level, but this is inferred beyond the text.
**[CHAR-5]** S — The evidence does not directly evidence spirit-level origin. The settled inner gravity implied by semnotēs may operate at the spirit level, but this is inferred beyond the text.

**[CHAR-6]** E — Psa51:12 evidences the spirit as the constitutional level at which willing-heartedness resides and from which it must be divinely restored after failure. The spirit is the origin point in the VCG-02 register — God upholds the spirit and the spirit's willing quality is thereby restored. In VCG-01, the heart is the primary constitutional location (Exo35:5/22; 2Ch29:31 — "willing heart"). Whether the spirit or heart is primary origin is register-dependent: in VCG-01, the heart; in VCG-02, the spirit.

**[CHAR-1]** E — The evidence does not explicitly identify humility's origin as spirit-level, but it points in that direction. The heart-location (Mat11:29 — "lowly in heart"; Lev26:41 — uncircumcised heart) suggests the characteristic operates at the deepest personal level. The contrast between performed humility (Col2:23 — "no value in stopping the indulgence of the flesh") and genuine inner transformation implies that genuine humility operates at a level deeper than conscious self-management — the level at which genuine character-transformation occurs. The constitutional depth required for the characteristic is consistent with spirit-level origin, even where the language does not explicitly name it.

**[CLUSTER]** E — For CHAR-3 and CHAR-6, spirit-level origin is evidenced: contrition reaches the spirit first (Psa34:18 — crushed in spirit) and willing-heartedness must be restored at the spirit level (Psa51:12 — uphold me with a willing spirit). For the other four, spirit-level origin is implied by the constitutional depth of their evidence without being explicitly named. The cluster-level inference: the spirit level is evidenced as the constitutional origin of the cluster's two most acute inner states (CHAR-3 — the most acutely broken; CHAR-6 — the most freely-willing). That the two extremes of the cluster (most broken; most freely-given) are both spirit-located is analytically significant — it suggests the spirit level is where M09's characteristics are most constitutionally concentrated, even when not explicitly named.

**[CHAR-1]** S — No evidence in the CHAR-1 corpus locates the origin of wilful sinning at the spirit level. The origin language in the corpus points to the heart as the inner source (Job 1:5 — "cursed God in their hearts"), the will as the active faculty (Eze 18:4; Gen 39:9), and external temptation as the triggering condition (Neh 13:26; Neh 6:13; 1Sa 15:24). Spirit-level origin is not evidenced.

**[CHAR-10]** S — No evidence locates the origin at the spirit level. Enticement originates in the desire-faculty (Jam 1:14); hypocrisy in social conformity pressure (Gal 2:13); apostasy in the will's departure from covenantal identity (Act 21:21).

**[CHAR-11]** E — Rom 5:12 — "sin came into the world through one man" — the origin is historical and corporate (through Adam) rather than at the spirit level of any individual person's constitution. The condition is received/inherited rather than self-originated at the spirit level. Joh 9:34 — "born in utter sin" — birth-origin framing: the condition is present from the person's beginning, not acquired through spirit-level choice. The origin is thus federal/representational (through Adam — Rom 5:12) rather than individual-spirit-level.

**[CHAR-12]** E — Partly. 1Jo 3:8 — "the devil has been sinning from the beginning" — the originary sinning is named as the devil's primordial activity; the devil's sinning from the beginning is the spirit-level source of the enslaving power's authority over those who practice sin. The enslaving power thus originates in the devil's originary spirit-level sinning, not in the creature's own spirit-level.

**[CHAR-13]** E — Not primarily. The record originates in acts (chat.tat as committed acts — Lev 4:23 — "the sin which he has committed"), in the heart's disposition (Deu 15:9 — "an unworthy thought in your heart"), and through inherited condition (Psa 51:5 — "in sin did my mother conceive me"). Jer 17:1 — the sin of Judah is engraved on the heart — the inscription is heart-level. The record thus originates in the heart's dispositional failures and the will's sinning acts rather than at the spirit level specifically; it produces spirit-level consequences (separation from God — Isa 59:2) without originating there.

**[CHAR-14]** E — The seeking dimension does not primarily originate at the spirit level: it originates in the will's volitional turning (Act 2:38 — "repent"), in the conscience's recognition (Lev 4:14 — "becomes known"), and in the community's ritual response. The receiving dimension, however, has a spirit-level consequence (Act 2:38 — Spirit received) and is enacted by God's sovereign act (2Cor 5:19 — "God was reconciling the world to himself"). The divine granting of forgiveness thus has a spirit-level source (God) even if the human seeking does not originate there.

**[CHAR-15]** E — Partially. Isa 43:27 — "your first father sinned" — the originating act of the first father is a will-level sinning act rather than exclusively a spirit-level phenomenon. However, Psa 78:32 — "despite his wonders, they did not believe" — the unbelief that drives the persistent sinning is a spirit-level failure: the failure to trust God's power and faithfulness at the deepest level of the person's God-orientation. The generational pattern thus has a spirit-level dimension in its sustaining mechanism (unbelief) even if its origin is in a specific volitional act.

**[CHAR-16]** E — Partly. The constituted sinner-identity through Adam (Rom 5:19 — "made sinners through one man's disobedience") operates at the spirit-level of the person's fundamental God-standing. The extreme-type sinner (VCG-03) whose moral character is thoroughly defined by sin has a spirit-level orientation against God: Gen 13:13 — "great sinners against the Lord" — the "against the Lord" names the spirit-level directional opposition. Luk 5:8's Peter — "I am a sinful man, O Lord" — recognises his spirit-level condition in the presence of divine holiness.

**[CHAR-17]** E — Partly. The guilt originates in an act (VCG-01 — violation that becomes known) or an inherited condition (VCG-02 — generational accumulation), not at the spirit level specifically. However, the guilt's registration as a moral-liability-before-God is spirit-level: Ezr 9:15 — "we are before you in our guilt" — the guilt-before-God orientation is the spirit-level dimension. The guilt originates in the act (will-level); the guilt-awareness before God is spirit-level.

**[CHAR-18]** E — Partly — through the heart-seated VCG-08 register. Eze 14:3 — "these men have taken their idols into their hearts, and set the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces" — the iniquity originates in the will's heart-level choice to receive idols inward; the crime begins at the spirit-level of the heart's allegiance. Job 15:5 — "your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the tongue of the crafty" — the iniquity originates at the level of inner orientation that then drives speech. The spirit-level is the origin of the most deeply-rooted iniquity (VCG-08); other registres (VCG-01 cultic; VCG-04 personal act) originate at the will and conduct levels.

**[CHAR-19]** E — Yes — the heart-origin of VCG-09 and the revolt-speech origin of VCG-02 both point to spirit-level origin. Psa 36:1 — "transgression speaks to the wicked deep in his heart" — the most explicit inner-origin statement in the corpus; the transgression speaks from the deepest inner level. Isa 59:13 — "conceiving and uttering from the heart lying words" — the revolt is conceived at the heart-level before being uttered. Eze 14:3 (CHAR-18 cross-reference level) — the idol-taking into the heart is the analogous spirit-level origin for iniquity; for CHAR-19, Psa 36:1's "deep in his heart" is the origin location.

**[CHAR-2]** S — No evidence locates the origin of unintentional sinning at the spirit level. The origin evidence (T1.7.1) points to epistemic limitation (lack of knowledge, limited perception) as the enabling condition — a feature of creaturely cognitive constitution, not specifically a spirit-level phenomenon.

**[CHAR-20]** E — Yes — Mal 2:15/16's "guard yourselves in your spirit" confirms that faithlessness originates at the spirit level: the guarding is against what would arise from within the spirit if left unguarded. 2Ch 28:22 — Ahaz becoming "yet more faithless" in distress — the progressive deepening of faithlessness is a spirit-level orientation-change under pressure. Isa 48:8 — "I knew you would surely deal treacherously" — the foreknown constitutional bent toward treachery is a spirit-level constitutional characterisation.

**[CHAR-21]** E — Partially — through VCG-03's Isa 29:16's cognitive-relational inversion (the creature denying the creator) which is a spirit-level orientation-reversal. More clearly: Pro 6:14 — "with perverted heart devises evil" — the heart is the origin, and the heart operates at the person's deepest inner level. The primary originating faculty is the heart (Pro 6:14) and the desire-faculty (Eph 4:22 — "through deceitful desires") rather than the spirit specifically — but the heart-level origin is close to the spirit-level of covenantal orientation.

**[CHAR-22]** E — Partially — through the God-ignorance and heart-atheism passages that are adjacent to spirit-level. Psa 53:1 — "the fool says in his heart, 'There is no God'" — the heart-level denial of God is what produces the injustice; Job 18:21 — "him who knows not God" — the God-ignorance that defines the unjust person is a spirit-level relational condition (not knowing God at the spirit-level of covenantal relationship). The characteristic does not originate explicitly at the spirit level but arises from a spirit-level God-relationship deficit that then manifests at the heart and conduct levels.

**[CHAR-3]** S — No evidence locates confession's origin at the spirit level. The origin evidence points to the heart/conscience (2Sa 24:10 — "David's heart struck him") and to inner knowledge (2Sa 19:20 — "your servant knows that I have sinned") as the originating faculties.

**[CHAR-4]** S — No evidence locates the origin of conscience suppression at the spirit level. The origin evidence points to: absence of God-knowledge (1Cor 15:34), absence of fear of God (Ecc 8:12), and self-interested false innocence claims (Jer 2:35) — all of which are mid-level inner-being phenomena rather than explicitly spirit-level.

**[CHAR-5]** S — No evidence locates the origin at the spirit level. The origin evidence points to the heart (2Ki 10:31 — "not with all his heart"), inherited moral orientation (the Jeroboam-sin pattern), and deliberate volitional choice (Heb 10:26). These are heart-and-will-level phenomena.

**[CHAR-6]** S — No evidence locates the origin at the spirit level. The origin evidence points to the heart's hardening (Exo 9:34), transferred allegiance to other gods (2Ki 17:7), and inherited communal patterns (Hos 10:9). These are heart-will-relational-level phenomena.

**[CHAR-7]** S — No evidence locates the origin at the spirit level. The origin evidence points to the leader's personal inner will (walking in the sinning path — 1Ki 16:26) and their authority position (1Ki 16:2) rather than to spirit-level phenomena.

**[CHAR-8]** S — No direct evidence locates the origin at the spirit level. The origin evidence points to volitional-social dynamics (the perceived weakness of authority — 2Ki 1:1/3:5; the ruler's spiritual abandonment — 2Ch 21:10) rather than to spirit-level phenomena.

**[CHAR-9]** S — No evidence locates the origin of sinful speech at the spirit level of the practitioner. The origin evidence points to the heart (Mat 15:19) and to inner conditions of conceit and craving (1Ti 6:4), not to the spirit-level constitutional faculty.

**[CHAR-1]** S — The evidence does not address spirit-level origin for wickedness-as-settled-person-identity. The deepest constitutional location evidenced is the heart (Psa 36:1 — "transgression speaks deep in his heart"; Psa 10:13 — "renounce God and say in his heart"). Whether this constitutes spirit-level depth in the programme's taxonomy is not directly evidenced; the verse corpus consistently uses heart and soul vocabulary, not spirit vocabulary.

**[CHAR-2]** S — The evidence does not indicate spirit-level origin. The constitutional framing (Mat 7:17-18 — VCG-02 — tree-nature determining fruit; Mar 7:23 — VCG-03 — all evil coming from within) does not specify the spirit as the originating faculty. The heart and the "inside" of the person are the specified constitutional loci. Spirit-level origin is not evidenced in this corpus.

**[CHAR-3]** S — Spirit-level origin is not indicated in this corpus. The evidence roots abomination in the heart (VCG-02 and VCG-01) and in the state of the conscience (VCG-04), not in the spirit faculty specifically. The constitutional depth implied (Pro 26:25 — seven abominations in the heart; Pro 11:20 — crooked heart) suggests the characteristic reaches the innermost integrating centre, but this is named as heart rather than spirit in the Hebrew vocabulary.

**[CHAR-4]** S — Spirit-level origin is not indicated. The evidence roots the characteristic in the heart (Eze 11:21 — heart going after idols — VCG-05), the soul (Isa 66:3 — soul delighting in abominations — VCG-04), and the eyes (Eze 20:7 — eyes feasting — VCG-05) — all of which are soul-level or sub-soul-level faculties in the programme's taxonomy. Spirit-level origin is not specifically evidenced.

**[CHAR-5]** S — Spirit-level origin is not indicated. The evidence roots the characteristic in the heart and thought-life (Isa 32:6 — VCG-02: "heart is busy with iniquity"; Isa 59:7 — VCG-02: "thoughts are thoughts of iniquity") and in the hand (Job 11:14 — VCG-04: "iniquity is in your hand") — all soul-level or expressive-level locations. Spirit-level origin is not specifically evidenced.

**[CHAR-6]** S — Spirit-level origin is not indicated. The characteristic originates in the hardened will (VCG-01 — "did not repent"), in authority-rejection (Jude 8 — VCG-01), and in moral failure affecting social testimony (VCG-02 — Rom 2:24). These are will and cognitive-moral locations, not spirit-level designations.

**[CLUSTER]** S — Spirit-level origin is not evidenced for any of the six characteristics. All six root their respective evil-forms in heart, mind, soul, or will — the soul-level constitutional faculties — rather than in spirit. This cluster-level pattern confirms that M10b addresses soul-level and will-level phenomena primarily. Char 5's exclusively OT Hebrew corpus (a.ven, ro.a) offers no NT pneuma-level evidence; Char 2's NT corpus (ponēros) most closely approaches spirit-level language through the cosmic-evil-agent sub-corpus (VCG-01) but even there the framing is in terms of the evil one's domain rather than the human spirit's condition.

**[CHAR-1]** S — No. The origin of the ritual defilement-state is consistently bodily — through physical contact (M10c-A), through bodily condition assessed by examination (M10c-B). The spirit-level register appears in Characteristic 2 (moral-inner defilement: 2Cor 7:1 names "defilement of body and spirit") but that verse is in M10c-C, outside Characteristic 1's corpus. Within the 133 verses, the characteristic is primarily a bodily-mechanism or verdict-mechanism condition, not a spirit-origin phenomenon.

**[CHAR-2]** E — The evidence shows the characteristic inhabiting the spirit level but not originating there. The origin evidence (T2.9 below) points to desire and habitual sin as the generative forces (Rom 1:24, Eph 4:19, VCG-02), which operate at the soul level of will and desire. The characteristic penetrates to the spirit level (2Cor 7:1) — it is the condition that has seeped down from the soul's volitional and desiderative functions into the deepest constitutional level. Origin is at the soul-desire/will level; penetration reaches to the spirit level.

**[CHAR-3]** S — Not evidenced at the spirit level. The origin evidence (T2.9 below) points to the community's volitional and covenantal defection as the generating force — this is a soul-level (will, desire, heart allegiance) phenomenon that produces consequences at the level of sacred spaces and relationships. The spirit-level penetration evidenced in Characteristic 2 (2Cor 7:1 — "defilement of body and spirit") is not paralleled in Characteristic 3's Hebrew corpus.

**[CHAR-4]** E — Yes, uniquely within the M10c cluster. The characteristic originates from an external spirit and its primary site of operation is the person's spirit-level constitution. The unclean spirit enters and operates at the spirit level, which is why the domination is total: Luk 8:29 (VCG-01) — the spirit's control overrides all bodily resistance (breaking chains), not because it acts at the bodily level first but because it controls the person at the deepest constitutional level. This distinguishes Characteristic 4 from Characteristic 2, where the defilement penetrates to the spirit level from the soul's desire-level inward; Characteristic 4 arrives at the spirit level directly from an external spiritual agent.

**[CLUSTER]** E — The cluster reveals two distinct spirit-level relationships: penetration from below (Characteristic 2) and invasion from outside (Characteristic 4). Characteristic 2 originates at the soul level (desire and will — Rom 1:24, Eph 4:19) and penetrates downward to the spirit level (2Cor 7:1) — origin is soul-desire, reach is spirit. Characteristic 4 originates entirely at the spirit level from an external source (the unclean spirit enters and dominates at the person's spirit level directly — Luk 8:29) — origin is spirit-level, and it arrives from outside. This distinction is analytically significant: Characteristic 2 shows how the soul's own volitional defection can ultimately reach the person's deepest constitutional level; Characteristic 4 shows that the spirit level can also be reached from outside through adversarial spiritual invasion without any volitional participation of the person. The cluster thus presents two routes to spirit-level defilement: internal-descending (Char 2) and external-invading (Char 4).

questions.question_text: What does spirit-level location reveal about the nature and depth of this characteristic?

findings.session_b_note:
Spirit-level location reveals three things about forgiveness's nature and depth:

1. **It cannot be self-generated by the human person:** If forgiveness originates at the spirit level — in God's own disposition and in the Spirit's mediating work — then the human capacity to receive and extend genuine forgiveness is not a natural human achievement but a derived capacity. The human person accesses it from a source beyond themselves. This is structurally consistent with the OT evidence: the salach-root is exclusively divine; humans can only seek, not generate, forgiveness at that register.

2. **Its depth is greater than the relational surface:** A characteristic that originates at the spirit level is not merely a social or psychological phenomenon. The inner-being depth of forgiveness — reaching the condition of guilt before God, restoring standing, generating love-orientation and reverence — is consistent with spirit-level operation. The sustained effects (hope, love, fear) are constitutionally deeper than surface-level social transactions.

3. **Its permanent limit (Mar 3:29) is a spirit-level event:** The unforgivable sin is framed as a Spirit-rejection — a spirit-level refusal. The fact that the only permanent foreclosure of forgiveness is located at the spirit level confirms that forgiveness's deepest operation occurs there. The outer limit defines the depth.

Grace reaches the deepest level of the person — the primary site of encounter with God. It does not operate only at the level of feeling, thought, or behaviour. SD008 (Eph 2:1-5: grace addressing the dead — the person without inner resource at the deepest level) and SD026 (grace producing even the capacity for supplication — reaching to the level of the person's capacity for response) both confirm that spirit-level operation means grace can reach what nothing else can reach.

*Consistent with prior analysis. Adds T2 framing.*

findings.session_b_note:
Spirit-level location reveals that contrition is not primarily an emotional phenomenon (which would be located at the soul/heart level) but a constitutional re-orientation at the deepest level of the person's being before God. The spirit is the locus of the creature's relationship to the Creator — the breath of life given by God (Gen 2:7) and the site of God's animating presence. Contrition at the spirit level therefore means that the inner being is re-oriented at the very point of its God-relatedness — not merely its feelings or its thinking, but its fundamental constitution before God.

This accounts for the verse evidence's consistent linking of spirit-level contrition with divine response: the God who animates spirit is specifically responsive to the spirit that acknowledges its creaturely dependence. Spirit-level contrition is the deepest possible form of the creaturely posture before God.

*New finding: the spirit-level location of contrition, read in the context of Hebrew anthropology's understanding of ruach as the God-given life-force, reveals contrition as a constitutional re-orientation at the point of God-relatedness — deeper than emotion or cognition. This connects the data to the DIM-30-SD001 question about contrition as the "penitential sub-form of Dependence/Creatureliness" and clarifies why it belongs there.*

findings.session_b_note:
Where fellowship operates at the spirit level (vertical groups, divine nature participation), it reveals that the characteristic operates at the deepest point of the person's constitutional structure — the point at which the person is most open to divine influence and most capable of genuine ontological change. Spirit-level fellowship is not merely relational in the social sense; it is the constitutional ground from which all other fellowship flows.

**New finding:** The data implies a constitutional hierarchy within fellowship: spirit-level fellowship (participation in divine nature) is the deepest register, from which soul-level fellowship (moral formation through companionship) and body-level fellowship (wounding as purification mechanism) derive their ultimate significance. findings.finding_value: T2 establishes that contrition operates at the deepest constitutional level (spirit as primary locus) with secondary engagement at heart, soul, and body. The constitutional portrait is comprehensive: spirit broken at the innermost level, heart broken at the moral-evaluative level, nephesh crushed at the whole-self level, and bones as the somatic expression of the inner breaking. What T2 reveals as a whole is the embodied depth of contrition — it is not a disembodied inner experience but a constitutional event that traverses all levels of the person. The bidirectional constitutional movement (downward through divine confrontation, upward through reviving) is the structural frame within which contrition functions: it reaches the bottom and creates the conditions for movement back upward. The T2.8 finding (no body deposit) means contrition does not leave a permanent somatic trace — it is a passing constitutional event, not a permanent constitutional mark.

Definition and constitutional location are structurally co-determining for this characteristic.

findings.finding_value: T2 produces the most distinctive constitutional portrait in the current review set. Spirit-level location is entirely absent — three consecutive S ratings — forming a new gap. By contrast, soul-level (chesed as covenantal-soul character), heart-level (Hos 11:8 — "my heart recoils"), and somatic-level (re.chem, splanchnon) are all richly evidenced. The constitutional architecture is bottom-up: the womb and entrails are the originating ground; the soul and heart are the engagement points; the act is the constitutional expression. Four body-part functions are identified: constitutive (womb — the generative image of compassion), expressive (gut — the felt movement), indicative (Synoptic pattern — splanchnizō signals the compassion-event), and mediating (heart in Hos 11:8 — the deliberative locus where compassion and judgment contend). The four-stage constitutional movement sequence (somatic arousal → soul engagement → volitional engagement → outward action) is uniquely evidenced in this registry — consistently inside-out and bottom-up. T2.8 established no body deposit; T5.7 is formally closed. The constitutional portrait confirms the sb_classification (soul-body interface) and extends it: compassion is the most somatically grounded characteristic in the programme, with its originating logic residing in the body's deepest interior.

The externalised-act kind is the constitutional endpoint of T2.10's four-stage movement sequence. T1's definition and T2's constitutional account are co-determining: the characteristic cannot be adequately defined without specifying the constitutional levels at which its four kinds operate.

The spirit level as reception point (T2.1) and the God-to-human direction as primary (T4.1) are mutually explanatory: because grace originates with God and is received at the spirit level, the primary relational direction is necessarily God-initiated toward the human spirit. The human-to-God direction (T4.2 — supplication) corresponds to T2.10's constitutional movement in reverse: the soul's recognition of need translates into the somatic enactment of supplication (prostration, fasting, sackcloth), which is T2.7's bidirectional body-soul finding. findings.finding_value: T2's constitutional levels are carried by specific grammatical forms in T7. The spirit-reception level (T2.1) is carried by the perfect passive form of charitoō (kecharitōmenē — the completed act of being-made-the-object-of-grace, with continuing state) — the most precise grammatical encoding of a constitutional arrival that has permanently changed the person's standing. The character-expression level is carried by chen in its conduct/speech register (889-003) and charizō in its human-forgiving mode. T7's NT coinage finding (charitoō invented to carry the standing-in-favour concept) is the lexical evidence that T2's spirit-level reception was conceptually unprecedented — no prior vocabulary could name what happened constitutionally when grace-as-standing arrived.

findings.finding_value: The constitutional movement patterns (T2.10 — constitutive spirit→mind, expressive inner→body, transformative outside-in→inside renewed→inside-out) directly correspond to the formation mechanisms (T5.3 — gradual formation, encounter/event, sovereign reversal). The constitutive movement (spirit→mind) corresponds to the gradual-formation mechanism: Spirit given to instruct forms inner capacity over time through repeated constitutional deepening. The expressive movement (inner→body) corresponds to the encounter/event mechanism: the covenantal giving event produces an immediate inner-to-outer response (altar-building). The transformative movement (outside-in→inside renewed→inside-out) corresponds to sovereign reversal: the eschatological giving reaches in and renews, then the renewed inner life expresses outward (praise). What this pair reveals: constitutional movement and formative mechanism are two descriptions of the same transformative process. The characteristic forms the person through the constitutional pathways by which it moves — formation is constitutional movement over time.

findings.finding_value: The spirit-level location of trembling-at-God's-word in Isa 66:2 reveals that this form of reverential sobriety is constitutionally deeper than somatic trembling: it originates in the person's deepest self and expresses through the body. Isa 66:2's pairing with "humble and contrite spirit" positions this trembling as emerging from the same constitutional depth as contrition and humility — characteristics that the programme has confirmed operate at spirit level. This establishes a category of reverential trembling that is not a fear-response to threat but a spirit-posture of deep creaturely sobriety before God's communication.

The spirit-level location of timidity (2Ti 1:7) reveals that cowardly shrinking is not merely a situational weakness or temperamental trait — it is a constitutional failure at the deepest level. By naming it a spirit-level disposition God has not implanted, Paul identifies timidity as a replacement or absence at the person's constitutional core. This also implies that courage is itself a spirit-level characteristic — the spirit God does implant (power, love, self-control) is the spirit-level positive of which timidity is the spirit-level failure.

Where spirit-level location is evidenced (E-VCG-02, G-VCG-01), it reveals fear as operating at the deepest constitutional level. Spirit-level fear (whether the reverential trembling of Isa 66:2 or the failed constitution of 2Ti 1:7) is constitutional in the deepest sense — it defines what kind of person the individual is, not merely what they experience at a given moment.

Spirit-level location in Eze 3:14 and Act 17:16 reveals that anger/indignation at its deepest reaches the most interior dimension of the person. Eze 3:14's "felt inner heat in his spirit" suggests this is not a surface emotional experience but an engagement of the person at the level where God's Spirit and the human spirit most closely interact. Paul's spirit being provoked by idolatry positions the moral-perception faculty (which perceives wrongdoing) at the spirit level. The finding is that anger, at its most morally serious, originates from or engages the deepest stratum of the inner person.

The spirit-level instances reveal that grief reaches its deepest constitutional depth when it arrives at the spirit. Job's complaint cannot be held back once anguish is located in his spirit (Job 7:11) — spirit-level grief produces unrestrained outward expression. The Spirit's groanings are too deep for words (Rom 8:26) — grief at the spirit level transcends linguistic expression and requires the Spirit's own intercession. Spirit-level grief is therefore the most profound, least expressible, and most covenantally significant register of the characteristic: the groan too deep for words is the inner cry at its most foundational.

**[CHAR-2]** E — Spirit-level location for Joy reveals that its deepest and most paradox-transcending form — joy amid suffering, inexpressible joy in the unseen Christ (1Pe 1:8) — operates at the deepest constitutional level, below and beyond the affective and cognitive faculties. Mary's "my spirit rejoices" (Luk 1:47) locates this exultation in the innermost self before it reaches the heart and mind. Jesus' rejoicing "in the Holy Spirit" (Luk 10:21) shows that the purest divine-image expression of Joy is Spirit-mediated. The spirit-level location explains the characteristic's capacity to transcend adverse circumstances: joy operating at the spirit level is not accessible to the same distortions that affect heart-level and mind-level emotional states.

**[CHAR-7]** E — Spirit-level location reveals that Suffering-Joy in its fullest form is not a human psychological achievement but a divinely-produced inner state. This explains the paradox: the person who genuinely exults amid suffering is not stronger-willed or more emotionally resilient than others but is inhabited by the Spirit at the deepest constitutional level. Spirit-level location also explains the characteristic's transcendence of circumstances: what is produced at the spirit level is not accessible to the same distortions that affect heart-level and mind-level inner states, which is why it can coexist with and even arise through suffering that would overwhelm ordinary affective joy.

**[CHAR-3]** S — Not applicable — spirit-level location is not evidenced. The significance of this silence: unlike Characteristic 7 (Suffering-Joy, where Spirit-mediation is prominent) and some registers of Joy, Gladness does not appear as a Spirit-produced inner state in this corpus. Its depth is evidenced at the evaluative-cognitive and affective levels rather than at the spirit level.

**[CHAR-4]** E — The absence of spirit-level location reveals Delight as characteristically a soul-and-heart-level phenomenon — it is the inner being's own native capacity for pleasurable orientation rather than a Spirit-imparted transcendent state. This distinguishes Delight from Suffering-Joy (which requires Spirit-enabling to transcend circumstances) and from the most intense registers of Joy. Delight arises from within the person's own constitutional inner being as a natural capacity that directs itself toward objects. The question of its disorder is therefore entirely a question of which object the native capacity attaches to — not whether the Spirit is present.

**[CHAR-5]** E — The absence of spirit-level location reveals Pleasure as the most constitutionally embodied positive characteristic in M04. Unlike Suffering-Joy (primarily spirit-level) and Delight (primarily inner-being/soul), Pleasure is the characteristic most directly connected to the body's sensory and material registers. This embodied quality is consistent with the ni.cho.ach aroma's physical-sensory character and the a.nog/ta.a.nug luxury register's explicit bodily orientation.

**[CHAR-6]** E — The absence of spirit-level location reveals Wonder as a naturally-arising creaturely capacity — it does not require special Spirit-production to occur; the finite being naturally experiences Wonder when genuinely encountering what exceeds its comprehension. This distinguishes Wonder from Suffering-Joy (Spirit-produced) and from the highest registers of Joy (Spirit-filled). Wonder is the characteristic most available to unregenerate persons as well as the redeemed — any person who genuinely encounters the extraordinary will experience some form of Wonder. Neh 9:17's failure ("did not consider your wondrous works") is a failure of attention, not a Spirit-absence.

**[CLUSTER]** E — Spirit-level location in Joy (Char 2) and Suffering-Joy (Char 7) reveals these two characteristics as the cluster's most transcendence-capable: the Spirit operates below and beyond the affective and cognitive faculties, producing inner states that are not accessible to the same circumstantial distortions as heart-level and mind-level states. This explains why Suffering-Joy can coexist with genuine grief (1Pe 1:6), why Mary's spirit exults in a vulnerable situation (Luk 1:47), and why Jesus rejoices in the Holy Spirit in the context of the disciples' ministry exposure (Luk 10:21). Spirit-level operation is what enables the paradox to be genuine rather than performed: the joy that is "inexpressible and filled with glory" (1Pe 1:8) is not manufactured by the will or produced by the emotions but arises from below both through the Spirit's presence. The absence of spirit-level location in the other five characteristics reveals them as the cluster's constitutionally native positive states — present in the soul-heart-mind from creation rather than requiring special divine enabling.

Dan 5:20's pairing of spirit-hardening with heart-lifting suggests that CHAR-1 at its most entrenched involves simultaneous engagement at both levels — the heart as the seat of the conscious self-elevation and the spirit as the deepened hardening that makes reversal increasingly resistant.

**[CLUSTER]** E — CHAR-1's spirit-level evidence (Dan 5:20: spirit hardened; Pro 16:18: haughty spirit) reveals that the deepest form of self-elevation — when it has progressed sufficiently — penetrates to the spirit level, hardening the deepest inner faculty against God's corrective action. The other four characteristics' silence at the spirit level indicates that CHAR-2 (a specific act), CHAR-3 (a communicative expression), CHAR-4 (a cognitive condition), and CHAR-5 (a structural-goods-dependent posture) do not in their primary evidence reach the spirit-level depth that CHAR-1's dispositional self-elevation reaches in its most entrenched form.

**[CHAR-2]** E — To the extent spirit-level depth is implied (T2.1.2), it reveals that genuine submission cannot be produced by surface-level pressure or social accountability alone. Phili2:12 — the sustained obedience that must persist "much more in my absence" (when external accountability is removed) requires an origin deeper than socially-accountable compliance — the conscience and fear of God replace the apostle. This implies an inner-generativity of the characteristic that is consistent with spirit-level depth: the person who genuinely submits does so from an inner posture that does not require external support, suggesting the characteristic is generated at a constitutional depth below the social-relational surface.

**[CHAR-3]** E — Spirit-level location reveals that contrition is the deepest possible inner-being state — it reaches the innermost constitutional level of the person. A breaking that is only at the surface (emotion, behaviour) without reaching the spirit would not be genuine contrition in the biblical sense. Isa57:15's framing — the high-and-holy God dwelling with the contrite spirit — implies that the spirit-level location makes the characteristic the point of closest divine-human contact: where the person's spirit is genuinely crushed, God's spirit revives. The constitutional depth of the characteristic (spirit-level) is what makes it the site of the deepest divine-human encounter.

**[CHAR-4]** S — Spirit-level location is not directly evidenced in the two-verse corpus. The depth implied by genuine metriopatheō (grounded in shared creaturely vulnerability, not in surface performance) is consistent with spirit-level operation, but the evidence does not name this explicitly.
**[CHAR-5]** S — Spirit-level location is not directly evidenced. The characteristic's depth as a settled character quality is consistent with spirit-level operation but is not named as such in §3.D.

**[CHAR-6]** E — Psa51:12's spirit-level location reveals that willing-heartedness operates at the deepest constitutional level of the person — the spirit as the innermost faculty. When the spirit is burdened by moral failure (Psa51 context), the willing quality of the spirit is lost and cannot be self-restored; it requires divine upholding. This depth of constitutional location explains why willing-heartedness cannot be coerced: external compulsion cannot reach the spirit level to produce genuine willingness — it can only produce outer compliance while the spirit remains unwilling or burdened.

**[CHAR-1]** E — To the extent spirit-level location is implied, it reveals that humility is not achievable by surface-level adjustment or external discipline alone. The Colossian exposure of false humility (Col2:18; Col2:23) evidences that self-imposed severity — operating at the level of conscious behaviour and physical practice — cannot produce genuine humility, which requires a transformation at a level below conscious management. This is consistent with spirit-level depth: the genuine characteristic must be generated from the innermost person, not merely adopted at the behavioural surface. The heart-language of Lev26:41 ("uncircumcised heart") and Mat11:29 ("lowly in heart") confirms that the genuine article operates at constitutional depth.

**[CLUSTER]** E — The spirit-level location of CHAR-3 and CHAR-6 reveals two different constitutional depths. For CHAR-3 Contrition: spirit-level location explains why genuine contrition cannot be coerced — external compulsion cannot reach the spirit to produce genuine crushing; the breaking must come from within through genuine confrontation with moral reality. For CHAR-6 Willing-heartedness: spirit-level location explains why genuine willing-heartedness cannot be manufactured — the freely-springing spirit cannot be pushed from outside; when it is lost (Psa51:12), only divine upholding at the spirit level can restore it. The cluster-level implication for all six: M09 characteristics are constitutionally deep — they require formation at the innermost level of the person, whether that is explicitly named as spirit (CHAR-3, CHAR-6) or implied by the depth of transformation evidenced (CHAR-1's uncircumcised heart; CHAR-2's soul-purification in 1Pe1:22). M09 cannot be inhabited at the surface.

The condition is not peripheral (merely moral-behavioural) but foundational (the spirit's capacity for life before God is extinguished). This explains why the remedy requires the Spirit's external convicting work (Joh 16:8/9 — "the Spirit will convict the world concerning sin") — the condition is at a level that cannot be self-diagnosed or self-corrected; it requires divine penetration.

**[CHAR-12]** E — Spirit-level location (1Jo 3:8/9 — devil's sinning as origin; new birth as counter at same level) reveals that the enslaving power is not merely a behavioural pattern but an identity-belonging claim at the deepest constitutional level. The enslaving power's spirit-level operation explains why new birth (a spirit-level transformation — 1Jo 3:9) is required for liberation: the power must be countered at the same constitutional depth at which it operates. Behavioural modification alone cannot address a spirit-level enslavement.

**[CHAR-13]** E — The spirit-level consequence (Isa 59:2 — separation and God's hidden face) reveals that the divine record's ultimate harm operates at the deepest constitutional level: it disrupts the person's most fundamental relational capacity — the spirit's access to God. The record is not merely a legal notation but a relational barrier at the spirit level. Jer 31:34's new-covenant promise — "I will remember their sin no more" — promises spirit-level restoration: the erasure of the record restores the spirit's God-access.

**[CHAR-14]** E — Spirit-level location (Act 2:38 — Spirit received after forgiveness; Col 2:13 — alive after dead-in-trespasses) reveals that forgiveness received operates at the deepest constitutional level of the person's capacity for God-relation: the Spirit's indwelling is the spirit-level consequence of the sin-record's removal. The forgiveness addresses what was blocking the spirit-level God-relationship (the sin-record creating separation — Isa 59:2 in CHAR-13's corpus) and opens the person to spirit-level restoration (Spirit received).

**[CHAR-15]** E — Spirit-level location (Eze 37:23 — defilement through idolatry; unbelief — Psa 78:32) reveals that generational sin operates at the deepest constitutional level of the community's God-relationship: the idolatry that defiles (Eze 37:23) is a spirit-level misorientation of the community's allegiance from God toward idols; the unbelief (Psa 78:32) is the spirit-level failure of trust that perpetuates the sinning across generations. The divine cleansing required (Eze 37:23) is therefore spirit-level restoration, not merely behavioural correction.

**[CHAR-16]** E — Spirit-level location (Heb 7:26 — incompatibility with holiness; Isa 33:14 — cannot dwell with consuming fire; Jam 4:8 — hearts requiring purification) reveals that the sinner-identity is not merely a social or behavioural classification but a constitutional inner reality that produces spirit-level incompatibility with God. The sinner's character makes them structurally unable to stand in the divine presence (Isa 33:14) and requires constitutional cleansing (Jam 4:8 — purify your hearts) that addresses the deepest inner level. This explains why Christ's saving mission (1Ti 1:15 — "came into the world to save sinners") must operate at the spirit level.

**[CHAR-17]** E — Spirit-level location (Ezr 9:15 — standing-disability before God; Hos 5:15 — God withdrawing until guilt acknowledged) reveals that guilt-as-inner-state disrupts the deepest level of the person's God-relationship. The guilt operates as a spirit-level barrier: the guilty person cannot stand before God (Ezr 9:15), God withdraws from the guilty community until they acknowledge (Hos 5:15), and the indelible stain remains before God regardless of self-cleansing effort (Jer 2:22). Spirit-level disruption is thus the characteristic's most profound consequence.

**[CHAR-18]** E — Spirit-level location (Psa 32:2 — "in whose spirit there is no deceit" as iniquity's absence; Isa 59:2 — separation from God; Eze 14:3 — heart-originated idolatry as iniquity's source) reveals that iniquity-as-accumulated-crime is not merely a behavioural or social category but penetrates to the spirit-level of the person's God-relationship. The spirit-level iniquity (Eze 14:3 — idol-taking into the heart) is the most severe form precisely because it originates at the person's deepest inner level of allegiance and orientation. The separation it produces (Isa 59:2) is a spirit-level relational rupture.

**[CHAR-19]** E — Spirit-level location (Eze 18:31 — new heart and new spirit as remedy; Psa 36:1 — speaks deep in the heart; Hos 8:1 — covenant-transgression) reveals that transgression-as-deliberate-boundary-crossing is not merely a surface behavioural category but a spirit-level reality that requires spirit-level renewal for its resolution. The fact that the remedy is a "new heart and new spirit" (Eze 18:31) confirms that the transgression has damaged the person at the deepest constitutive level. The God-relationship rupture (2Jo 9 — "does not have God") is the most severe spirit-level consequence.

The "guard yourselves in your spirit" command is remarkable for its precision — it identifies the spirit as the site of the characteristic's generation, requiring active vigilance at the deepest inner level to prevent faithlessness from arising. No other M10 characteristic is addressed with a spirit-vigilance command.

The constitutional portrait confirms the sb_classification (soul-body interface) and extends it: compassion is the most somatically grounded characteristic in the programme, with its originating logic residing in the body's deepest interior.

findings.session_b_note:
Yes. The soul-level location is established through the heart-locus evidence and the sb_classification reasoning:

- **Mat 18:35** — "if you do not forgive your brother **from your heart**." The heart (in Hebrew thought, lēb) encompasses the seat of the will and the whole inner personal life — the soul-level volitional centre. Q037 answer: "The human volitional act of forgiving from the heart. Mat 18:35 — 'from your heart' — the heart is the seat of the will and the whole inner person, which in Hebrew thought (lēb) encompasses the soul-level volitional life."

- The commanded human act of forgiveness (Luk 17:3-4) is described as within the human's volitional capacity — it is commanded, which implies it is achievable. Commands operate at the soul level.

- OBS-064-002 names the soul level as the **exercise-ground** of forgiveness: "spirit-level = the origin (God's disposition, divine act, transformative capacity); soul-level = the exercise (human volitional decision to release, commanded and achievable)."

findings.session_b_note:
Yes — the evidence consistently locates compassion at the soul level, primarily through the chesed and channum vocabulary and the character-quality (adjectival) terms.

H7349 ra.chum (compassionate) is an adjectival form naming the settled soul-level disposition — what kind of person one is constitutively. H2587 channum (gracious) is similarly a soul-level character descriptor, used almost exclusively as a divine attribute in the epithet formula. G4835 sumpathēs (sympathetic, 1 Pet 3:8) is placed in a list of soul-level character qualities alongside unity of mind, brotherly love, tender heart, and humble mind — all soul-level orientations.

The chesed vocabulary (H2617B, H2617A as XREF) names compassion-love as a settled inner disposition of covenantal loyalty — a soul-level character reality, not a momentary event. The group descriptions for 1633-001 (God's steadfast love), 1633-002 (human disposition of covenantal loyalty), and 1633-003 (trust and hope grounded in chesed) all operate at the soul level.

- **Psa 119:63** (*I am a companion of all who fear you*) — the choosing of companions based on moral alignment is a volitional act that engages what the programme locates at the soul level: deliberate inner-being choice and orientation.

- **Isa 1:23** (*companions of thieves*) — moral alignment with wickedness as a disposition of the inner person, engaging the soul's moral faculties.

The soul-level engagement is inferred from the volitional and moral-disposition character of these groups, not from explicit soul-vocabulary in the anchors.

findings.session_b_note: Cited as source by SYN-INTRA-067-002: T2 as a whole reveals that goodness has a comprehensive multi-level constitutional presence — from Spirit-level origin through soul-orientation, heart-engagement, and mind-evaluative functions to outw…
findings.finding_value: T2 as a whole reveals that goodness has a comprehensive multi-level constitutional presence — from Spirit-level origin through soul-orientation, heart-engagement, and mind-evaluative functions to outward expression — but with a marked asymmetry in evidence quality. Spirit-level (Q&A-037-039), soul-level (Q&A-040-041), and heart-level (Q&A-043-044) are all substantively evidenced. Mind-level is partially evidenced through cognitive dimensions. Body-level is thin — the gladness-of-heart compound (tov-lev) and the taste-and-see perceptual metaphor are the somatic markers, but no constitutional body deposit is evidenced (T2.8 silent). The most structurally significant T2 finding is the six-step constitutional movement (Q&A-064): Spirit-level origin → soul reorientation → heart engagement → volitional alignment → agentive resolve → outward expression. This movement is top-down and outward, with no evidenced reversal from body to inner being. Goodness is constitutionally deep but does not leave a somatic deposit.

findings.session_b_note: Yes — and with unusual density. Mat 22:37 ('love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind') explicitly names the soul (nephesh/psuchē) as one of the constitutional locations of love — love is commanded as a soul-act. Song 5:6 ('my soul failed me') locates love's absence at the soul level — the soul's vitality collapses when the beloved departs (OBS-103-062, SP-103-031). Jer 12:7 ('the beloved of my soul') attributes a nephesh to God with a beloved located in it (OBS-103-086) — the soul as the seat of love's deepest attachment. Joh 15:13 ('lay down his psuchē for his friends') makes love's maximum expression a soul-act — the giving of the soul itself. 1Th 2:8 ('ready to share our own souls') repeats this pattern (OBS-103-123). The soul is one of love's primary constitutional locations.
